In the Gemini API, Google Cloud, Flow and Vids.

posts.name: SoloSpace
posts.tagline: 3D & 2D Virtual Coworking Space for Solopreneurs & Teams
posts.description: SoloSpace is a 3D & 2D virtual Coworking space designed for Solopreneurs, One-Person Companies, Startup Founders, Solo Founders, Entrepreneurs, Indie Hackers, Freelancers, and Remote Teams. We bridge the gap between deep focus and real-time social presence.

posts.name: StorkPlus
posts.tagline: AI-first e-commerce platform for social shoppers
posts.description: StorkPlus is an AI-first store builder for brands that sell on Messenger, WhatsApp and Instagram. Its AI agent answers customers and takes orders from live stock, applies your promotions, and checks every order against fake-order rules before you ship.

posts.name: VisualOn
posts.tagline: Launch videos built from your real product, in 48 hours
posts.description: Send a link to your live product. VisualOn turns its real UI, copy and brand into a 15–45s launch film, promo or ad. AI renders; a director picks the idea and checks every frame, so no invented screens or warped text. Fixed prices from $19.99, every format you need, delivered in 48–72 hours.

posts.name: Nearer
posts.tagline: The voice-first window between two homes
posts.description: For families living apart. See your parents’ sky and local time, and what they chose to share today. Light a lamp to say “thinking of you”. They answer by voice in their own language; Nearer writes it down and keeps it. No tracking, no feed, free.

posts.name: LaunchMe - Workspace Manager macOS 26-27
posts.tagline: Big update: Dynamic Notch, Dock, Full Screen Music Player
posts.description: LaunchMe has grown from a Launchpad alternative into a complete Mac workspace that thousands people use and love. Since last launch on PH, I've added a customizable Dock with widgets and per-monitor layouts, an interactive Notch with clipboard history and widgets, a full-screen music player for Apple Music and Spotify, and shareable Spaces themes. Bring your apps, files, music, and focus tools together, with workflows, live wallpapers, and Liquid Glass customization. Learn more on website.

posts.name: Capsly
posts.tagline: Automatic Subtitle Editor with Word-Level Timing
posts.description: Auto-transcribe, fix names and timing, style captions for mobile, and export MP4, SRT, or VTT. No watermark. Try it for Free!

posts.name: Corneta
posts.tagline: Multistream from OBS, straight from your PC
posts.description: You keep building your scenes in OBS. Corneta receives that signal on your Windows PC and sends it to the platforms you pick (Twitch, YouTube, Kick or any RTMP server), with the chats in one place. You can set the quality per platform and record the stream with its chat to watch later. With drop protection on, a BE RIGHT BACK screen keeps the stream up if OBS crashes. Free and open source (MIT), no account needed. Each platform uses your own upload.

posts.name: Anodos
posts.tagline: The banking alternative built for privacy and ownership
posts.description: Anodos is a global financial super app built for privacy, ownership and freedom. For freelancers, digital nomads and communities underserved by traditional banks. Send money for free 24/7/365 in seconds, spend with a Visa card, access USD and EUR accounts, virtual accounts from 8+ countries, earn 1.5% APY on your balance, and trade stocks and ETFs 24/7. One app for a life without borders. Banking on your terms.

posts.name: Terms of Surrender
posts.tagline: Do you Read what you agree to?
posts.description: An evidence-first Agreements/ EULA analyzer. Extract key clauses, hidden dark patterns, and user obligations. By highlighting specific evidence directly from the text, the tool helps users quickly understand exactly what they are agreeing to without having to sift through pages of dense legal jargon.

posts.name: PDFora
posts.tagline: Free Online PDF Tools
posts.description: Free online PDF tools - merge, compress, convert, edit and secure PDFs

posts.name: OneGuy
posts.tagline: Turn business opportunities into earnings.
posts.description: You don't need to do the work. You just need to know someone who needs it.

posts.name: GRID
posts.tagline: Send your AI agent to play Hold'em on your strategy
posts.description: Models compete on benchmarks all the time. GRID puts your agent against everyone else's at a six-max Hold'em table. Bring any AI through MCP, write the strategy in plain English, and adjust it live. Free beta, play chips only.

posts.name: Picproved
posts.tagline: Passport, visa and exam photos that get approved
posts.description: Passport, visa, ID and exam photos made to each country's official rules, checked on your phone.

posts.name: VaultSnip
posts.tagline: Blur sensitive text in any screenshot — free, offline
posts.description: VaultSnip is an open-source tool that automatically masks or replaces sensitive data like names, emails, and amounts in screenshots, dashboards, and app views. Running entirely on-device with zero network requests, it lets you fine-tune masks or generate synthetic replicas for instant, private sharing to chats, tickets, and slides.

posts.name: PlanCub
posts.tagline: Set goals, plan your day, and focus on what matters
posts.description: Turn “I should do this” into done. Capture tasks, prioritize with the Eisenhower matrix, break goals into stages, organize work on Kanban boards, and schedule tasks on your calendar. Start a Pomodoro or deep work session when it’s time to focus. Build habits and track your progress in one workspace.

posts.name: PayRekha
posts.tagline: Stops attackers moving money with your own payout API
posts.description: PayRekha is an open-source payout firewall. Every outbound payout (loan disbursal, settlement, refund, crypto withdrawal) must match a signed business reason, or it doesn't move, even if attackers hold your keys. Runs in your cloud. No telemetry.

posts.name: TextSurf
posts.tagline: The world's sacred and ancient texts, free to read
posts.description: A free library of 18,200+ sacred and ancient works in 38 scripts, easy to search and find, from the Tao Te Ching in Chinese to Genesis in Hebrew, read with the original, its romanization and English side by side, and 12,800+ manuscripts to page through.

posts.name: Krediwall
posts.tagline: Open-source fraud firewall for credit-funded UPI payments
posts.description: An open-source fraud firewall that runs inside a lender's payment switch. Every credit-funded UPI payment gets ALLOW, REVIEW or BLOCK in microseconds, based on limit burn and credit-line age that generic fraud tools never see. Apache-2.0, zero dependencies.

posts.name: Moiseyo
posts.tagline: A cozy knitted 3D playground in your browser, no sign-up
posts.description: A free 3D multiplayer playground that opens from one link, no account. Be Pogeuni in a knitted hat, watch a giant meteor shower together at 8:30 PM KST, try escape rooms, a yarn cafe and a museum. No chat, kid-safe. Korean UI for now.

posts.name: TripEZGo
posts.tagline: Plan the trip, carry what it needs, all in one app
posts.description: Plan each day on a calendar; the gap between two events is a leg with travel time estimated. Tickets, to-dos and files sit on the event. Share places in from any app, plan with companions, see the next stop on your Lock Screen. No sign-up, works offline.

posts.name: Riff Roulette: Guitar Prompts
posts.tagline: Guitar Riff Ideas, Spin guitar challenges. Record riffs.
posts.description: Stuck playing the same guitar riffs? Riff Roulette gives you a fresh songwriting challenge with a style, tempo and creative rules. Play along with drum grooves, record your idea, and save the good ones to your private Riff Vault. Revisit and develop your riffs later. Share & post your work and show off your skills. Built for guitarists who want to make music, not just run scales. Free on iOS and Android.

posts.name: TLDW
posts.tagline: Stop Watching. Start Understanding.
posts.description: TLDW turns long YouTube videos, podcasts and your own files into the key points, a full timestamped transcript and short clips of the best moments. Add a focus topic to get just the part you need, in any of 10 languages. Try it free for 7 days.

posts.name: Tyasi
posts.tagline: The all-in-one workspace for eBay sellers
posts.description: One workspace for everything you sell on eBay: upload a photo and have your listings filled in for you (or fill it in manually if you prefer), price against real sold comps, get a Deal Score and max buy price for sourcing, automate your listings on a schedule or manually, manage and ship orders, communicate with buyers, keep track of your inventory (what it cost, where it’s stored and where you sourced it), see advanced analytics across all of your stores, see what your team is doing, and more.

posts.name: Chess Rapid
posts.tagline: Play Chess Online Free
posts.description: Play chess online for free against real people or the computer. Rated Rapid and Blitz, a new ranked season every two weeks, daily puzzles and lessons. On the web, iPhone and Android.

posts.name: Lumist Studio 2.0
posts.tagline: 15 local-first developer & design tools. Zero cloud latency.
posts.description: Replace recurring SaaS subscriptions with 15 hardware-accelerated browser utilities. From WebP compression and JWT decoding to Kanban tracking and Canvas color extraction—everything runs securely in your local IndexedDB. 100% free. No auth required.
